[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Count the Number of Fair Pairs** [LC 2563 · Count the Number of Fair Pairs](https://leetcode.com/problems/count-the-number-of-fair-pairs/){difficulty="Medium"}

The band identity of @sec-tp-p5-b solves this with two calls of `count_le`, and negative values change nothing, because `count_le` only reads the sorted order. The new idea is to count the band in **one** sweep. For each left element $a_i$ of the sorted array, its fair partners are the values in $[\mathit{lower} - a_i, \mathit{upper} - a_i]$, a contiguous block of indices. As $a_i$ grows, both ends of that value window move down, so the two block boundaries $L$ and $R$ only ever move **left**. Two boundary fingers, each moving at most $n$ times, count every block in $O(n)$ after the sort.

[Solved in full in @sec-tp-p5-c.]{.card-link}

:::
